recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有兩顆胞質豐富淡藍、帶細顆粒、只有單一大圓核的巨核細胞（箭頭），核未分葉，屬於單核／低分葉巨核細胞異生，周圍夾雜帶核仁的芽細胞，支持 AML 伴骨髓發育不良相關變化。
features: Two large cells with abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm and a single large round non-lobated nucleus (arrow), consistent with mononuclear megakaryocytes
Megakaryocyte nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, relatively immature for the cytoplasmic volume
Surrounding blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and visible nucleoli, including one with nuclear vacuolation/pseudo-inclusion
Scattered granulocytic precursors and dense erythroid cells
Fat vacuoles and red cells in a cellular particle area
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (high power) from a cellular particle shows two large megakaryocytes with abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm and single large, round, non-lobated nuclei (arrow), consistent with dysplastic mononuclear megakaryocytes. The surrounding cells include numerous blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and conspicuous nucleoli, one showing a nuclear vacuole, together with scattered granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Findings demonstrate megakaryocytic dysplasia in a blast-rich marrow, consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes in the appropriate cytogenetic context.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocytes in 5q- syndrome (MDS with isolated del(5q))
ddx.vs: del(5q) megakaryocytes are also small with non-lobated nuclei, but occur without blast excess and with isolated del(5q) on karyotype.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocytes in CML or other MPN
ddx.vs: CML megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated (dwarf) with myeloid hyperplasia and basophilia but no blast excess, and are BCR::ABL1-positive.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a pale hof distant from the nucleus and plasma cells are smaller with clock-face chromatin, rather than abundant granular megakaryocytic cytoplasm.
